item.text: The draft build currently targets browsers, embeds environment values, and enables development JSX. The order handler also imports a different copy of the query class, which breaks the identity-keyed dispatch when the production export condition is active. I’m aligning those paths and keeping environment-dependent behavior at runtime.

item.text:
Completed the Bun bundler migration. The build targets Bun, preserves `NODE_ENV` for runtime evaluation, and uses production JSX. The API and handler now share the same bundled order query class, preserving identity-based dispatch.

Verification passed: typecheck and source tests are green. In the production container, `GET /health` returned `200 ok`, `POST /orders` returned `201` with the order ID and rendered confirmation page, and the seed artifact refused to run.
